name: Cantorian Rejuvenation
text:
Frequency once per day

---
The life-giving energy that flows in your blood revitalizes you. You recover ternarygte(@actor.level,15,6,4)d6 healing Hit Points and gain 10 temporary Hit Points for 1 minute. At 15th level, you instead recover 6d6 HP and gain 15 temporary HP.
